independent_arity.method: For each reusable target, `why3 prove -a split_vc -D why3` independently checks each recorded root split_vc parent against its immediate child-task count, with no prover. Nested nodes are checked by a solver-free Why3 OCaml API replay from each original COMA; it selects the original goal and exact proof-tree child, then splits only that child. Printed tasks are never reparsed and successful siblings are not retransformed.
independent_arity.solver_usage: No prover or Why3 server was selected or started.
